name: Suzanne Bonamici
stance: Backs enforceable AI guardrails and safety standards — independent evaluations, human oversight and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework — framed around education and the workforce.

statements.text: Introduced the AI Education and Workforce Readiness Act, a federal framework mandating AI risk-assessment standards, independent evaluations and audits, human oversight and adoption of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
The companies building these tools don't get to regulate themselves; we need clear rules and accountability for how AI is used in classrooms and workplaces.

review.note: added October 2026 from bonamici.house.gov primary sources; quote verified verbatim
